summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, updating net asset value (NAV) per share and portfolio metrics as of August 31, 2026, with a transaction price effective October 1, 2026, set equal to each share class's NAV per share. The board, including independent directors, approved valuation procedures; Altus Group U.S. Inc. serves as independent valuation advisor. The disclosure is a routine periodic NAV update for a non-traded REIT, involving no special-situations event. No transaction terms, premium, or deal mechanics were provided. What to watch: routine NAV adjustments may imply valuation trends but do not constitute a deal.
